objective: Make BUKLOD comments reaction controls screen-safe, cluster/org Connect compact, synchronized cluster profile photos, expandable sponsored caption and unobstructed video playback, waveform-style music clip trimming, compact inbox header, informational Circle Rank highlight and collapsed Points history; preserve all back-end functions and prepare isolated code for consolidated OTA only.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main ce157c66f80978b0eb0d7f89c0766e0ca06c11dd and Expo runtime 1.3.2 observed in prior release source on 2026-11-08; this DEV branch is not a verified production OTA/RC or live deployment. Existing published production baseline and V30 binary identity must be compared independently at RC gate. No native dependencies, database, or release workflows changed.
chosenApproach: Target existing presentational components and an account-scoped signed photo hook, reuse long-press modal for viewport safety, retain scoped chat APIs, use a JS PanResponder and trim metadata instead of new media files, add disclosure UX to ledger and sponsor captions, add focused Node regression contracts.
selectionRationale: Avoid changes to backend, security, native runtime, ad campaign eligibility, reward accounting, and message protocols. Favor small isolated UI changes that can be smoke-tested before one consolidated OTA.
alternativeApproaches: Replace Connect messaging shell and reaction implementations: rejected for high regression risk to direct/scope chat and moderation.
Add server-side audio waveform transcoding and audio slicing for every post: rejected due to licensing, cost and new native requirements.
preserveBehaviors: Scoped room RLS, calls, attachment picker, message seen and read status, and keyboard-safe composer remain unchanged.
Signed scoped private photo storage and admin-only upload remain authoritative; no public media URL or caching between accounts.
Sponsored ad approvals, period expiry, geo-targeting, impressions, click tracking and in-viewport playback guard remain unchanged.
Existing licensed music catalog and 5–60 second clip metadata and seek playback remain unchanged.
Point ledger remains server-authoritative, notification focusLedgerId direct link expands history, Claim All unchanged.
Native runtime 1.3.2 and Play/AAB identity untouched; no production OTA/web deployment triggered.
acceptanceChecks: Comment action is an emoji; long press opens centered bounded reaction options, counts remain accessible, no horizontally out-of-screen tray.
Scoped direct and group messages keep reactions, photo, calls, attachments, unread indicators, while reducing vertical gaps.
Scoped image upload invalidates signed-photo cache and updates cluster list, Connect list and room header after focus.
Sponsor caption has See more/less, safe destination link preserved, custom play/pause button outside creative avoids native video overlay.
Music picker supports drag-to-move, resize start/end, 5–60 second clipping and exact time fallback.
Inbox hero is shorter; Circle Rank highlight opens information and Points shows collapsed history and group sources until opened.
Focused Node tests and protected CI run; no real OTA until separately verified frozen RC and runtime gate.
